newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Former U.S. senator to monitor Croatia poll-OSCE.
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. senator to monitor Croatia poll-OSCE.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said on Wednesday it had named former U.S. senator Paul Simon as Special Coordinator to oversee Croatia's presidential elections scheduled for June 15.

"Senator Simon will be expected to issue a consolidated final statement based on the monitoring reports of the OSCE's Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights (ODIHR) and other international organisations," the Vienna-based European security body said in a statement.
Some 120 observers are expected to monitor the elections for ODHIR, covering all major towns and regions in the country, the OSCE added.
